panel.title: Area of interest
panel.description: The same save and restore as the local demo, on a SEPAL session. Earth Engine is on, so the picker offers GEE assets and every selection is rebuilt as an ee object.

section.title: Select
section.description: Save writes {path}. The file methods are absent on purpose: a saved path means nothing to another user in a shared container, while an asset id and a drawn geometry travel.

switch.label: Process a restored AOI automatically
switch.hint: On: Restore draws the AOI straight away. Off: it fills the form and you press Select AOI.
